pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. comment.comment:
Why I’m holding KARDASHEV

Most coins are built for a moment. KARDASHEV is built for a direction.

The Kardashev Scale measures a civilization by the energy it can harness. First a planet, then a star, then a galaxy. It’s the clearest picture we have of where humanity is going, and this community lives that idea every day.

The mission is acceleration, energy and progress. That idea is bigger than any one cycle. The community is builders who show up daily and protect the culture. And the conviction is real. We’re not here to flip. We’re here to build something that lasts.

Every fee goes directly to the research. That means we aren’t just backing this, we’re building it. Every rocket needs the people who weld the metal and hammer the bolts. They matter as much as the astronauts, if not more. That’s us.

Phases fade because nothing holds them together. This one has a mission at its core.

There’s a lot at stake and we know it. That’s why we’re building carefully, together, for the long run.

I’m not here for the next candle. I’m here for the next civilization.

We’re early, but we’re exactly where we need to be. Everyone is welcome to scale with us, and I’m excited to see what’s in store.

Up the scale we go.
